audience: Make is for people who want a visual automation builder and will start on a free credit plan while the paid prices stay unread. It is a reasonable comparison when you already know n8n or Zapier and you want the visual canvas. It is a bad place to guess a Core, Pro, or Teams price. Those names are on the page. Their dollars were not in the text.
features: The free plan includes 1,000 credits a month. That figure is from the pricing page FAQ on 14 October 2026. Most actions consume one credit, which is the pro that makes the allowance legible. A scenario of single-credit actions is about a thousand actions, not a thousand scenarios full of hidden steps.

Core, Pro, and Teams are named, and annual billing is cheaper. Those are facts from the note. Cheaper is not a percentage we were given, so we do not print one. The paid row in our table says see the vendor site.
The free plan being stated on the pricing page is the other pro. You can open an account and spend the thousand credits without us inventing a checkout. That is as far as the verified text goes.
limitations: Paid dollar amounts were not in the page text. A direct HTML download of the same URL was a Cloudflare challenge. We will not fill Core, Pro, or Teams with prices from memory or from a blocked page. The rating is Pending because of that hole.
Credits expire at the end of the term. Unused free credits do not become a savings account. A quiet month is a lost month. Plan the work inside the term you are in.
